REVIEW_DECISION: REJECT
RISK_CLASS: high-impact
SUMMARY: The provenance validator unintentionally restricts every Factory-created change, including ordinary refactors, to the closed registry containing only Sol and Opus. This contradicts the explicit small-refactor policy and required safety property 6.
FINDING: high|scripts/factory-ng-provenance-validate.py|Every review is unconditionally required to match review-profiles/v1.json, which contains only Sol and Opus profiles|Ordinary refactor review must not be Sol/Opus-only
REQUIRED_CHANGE: Limit the Sol/Opus registry requirement to Factory-contract governance reviews, or define and validate a separate registry/policy allowing ordinary ticket reviewers.
COUNTEREXAMPLE: A behavior-preserving refactor passes snapshots and deterministic gates and has an accepted Qwen independent review receipt; validation fails with “review receipt is not bound to a registered reviewer identity.”
